#HMPV Detected in Bengaluru: 8-Month-Old Baby Affected
 
An eight-month-old baby in Bengaluru, India, has been identified as the first confirmed case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in 2025. The virus, which can cause respiratory infections, has been present in India for decades.
